description: Hand-labeled dataset for the Keeper's register (mood) classifier. Registers are an original construct (frozen = stuck/low/cold, tidal = moving/returning/better, turn = the rare strong lift, neutral = no mood signal -> abstain). Labels are subjective and authored by one person; treat as a directional benchmark, not ground truth. Held-out 'test' split is never used to tune thresholds. Optional external validation: map a public emotion set (e.g. dair-ai/emotion: sadness/fear -> frozen, joy/love -> tidal) for volume.
